1.web: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
1.asv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar-trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

2.web: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel; for his kingdom was exalted on high, for his people Israel’s sake.
2.asv: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel; for his kingdom was exalted on high, for his people Israel’s sake.

3.web: David took more wives at Jerusalem; and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
3.asv: And David took more wives at Jerusalem; and David begat more sons and daughters.

4.web: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
4.asv: And these are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

5.web: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,
5.asv: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,

6.web: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
6.asv: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

7.web: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
7.asv: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

8.web: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David: and David heard of it, and went out against them.
8.asv: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David: and David heard of it, and went out against them.

9.web: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
9.asv: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

10.web: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
10.asv: And David inquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And Jehovah said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thy hand.

11.web: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there; and David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like the breach of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
11.asv: So they came up to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and David said, God hath broken mine enemies by my hand, like the breach of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

12.web: They left their gods there; and David gave commandment, and they were burned with fire.
12.asv: And they left their gods there; and David gave commandment, and they were burned with fire.

13.web: The Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.
13.asv: And the Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.

14.web: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them over against the mulberry trees.
14.asv: And David inquired again of God; and God said unto him, Thou shalt not go up after them: turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry-trees.

15.web: It shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
15.asv: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle; for God is gone out before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

16.web: David did as God commanded him: and they struck the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
16.asv: And David did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

17.web: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
17.asv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Jehovah brought the fear of him upon all nations.
